checks.name: catalog-and-previews
checks.evidence: All catalog entries render; actual local preview images load and the desktop has no overflow.

checks.name: search-filter-reset
checks.evidence: Category and accent-insensitive Swedish search combine correctly; zero results offers a working reset.

checks.name: navigation-position-and-responsive-target
checks.evidence: Category changes return to the result beginning, and the selected effect remains in view after a mobile preview reflow.

checks.name: live-preview-and-saved-board
checks.evidence: A real study loads in one iframe, mobile sizing works, Escape releases it, and saved choices survive reload and reach the copy action. Clipboard content is captured locally during this check.

checks.name: inspiration-to-real-brief
checks.evidence: Saved study references and suggested techniques reach the real brief API and downloaded Markdown while preserving authored direction. Removing untouched suggestions clears them.

checks.name: deep-links-and-back
checks.evidence: Shared filter URLs reproduce their result set and browser Back closes a preview while preserving the category.
